nodes.name: Normalizar Estado para Monday en actualizar

httpHeaderAuth.name: Header Auth account  - Monday API Token Bodas.com.mx
Header Auth account  - Monday API Token Bodas.com.mx

parameters.query:
SELECT
  a.*,
  b.ID_Item_Monday AS ID_Item_Monday,
  b.Nombre         AS Nombre_Monday,
  c.`tour virtual`  AS tour_virtual,
  c.`my photo`      AS my_photo,
  c.`my photo cate` AS my_photo_cate,
  c.`default`       AS default_label,
  c.`no aplica`     AS no_aplica
FROM input1 a
LEFT JOIN input2 b
  ON TRIM(CAST(a.`Company ID` AS TEXT)) = TRIM(b.`ID_Venue`)
CROSS JOIN input3 c
